description: A highly customizable, in-game teleprompter for Minecraft. Features live text-file syncing, Markdown formatting, and automatic dialogue highlighting for recording videos.

mods.name: Teleprompter
mods.description: An on-screen teleprompter for script recording.

releases.notes:
Auto-Scroll & Timing Engine:
- Added 'News Anchor' Auto-Scroll (Toggle with P) based on a configurable WPM setting.
- Added Smart Wait Commands (e.g., `## WAIT 5 SECONDS` or `2m`, `500ms`). The engine pauses and dynamically counts down to 0 on-screen.
- Added unbound hotkeys for Play/Pause, Skip to Next Line, and Skip to Prev Line.
- Auto-Scroll intelligently skips blank lines instantly to maintain pacing.
- Auto-Scroll completely freezes when the game is paused via the Escape menu.
- Re-enabling Auto-Scroll at the end of a page automatically resets the index to the top.

Smart Formatting & Rendering:
- Implemented 'Smart Alignment' mode (Default): Stage directions and Wait commands perfectly center themselves, while Dialogue aligns left.
- Ironclad Dialogue Engine: A line is now only considered dialogue if it contains a colon (:) AND quotation marks ("). 
- Invisible Quotes: Quotation marks are used for backend detection but are cleanly stripped from the final in-game render.
- Paragraph Protection: The text wrapper now detects if a sentence will be cut in half by a page limit and cleanly pushes the entire paragraph to the next page.
- Highlight bars dynamically extract and inherit the color of the text they are highlighting.

UI & Quality of Life:
- UI Scaling Fix: The prompter now respects native Minecraft Logical GUI scaling instead of absolute monitor resolution.
- Added smooth sliding animations for page transitions.
- Added a Script Cycling hotkey (O) to instantly rotate through all .txt files in the config folder (resets view to Page 1).
- Reorganized the ModMenu settings into logical Main, Visuals, and Formatting tabs.
- The "Force Sync Scripts" button now seamlessly rebuilds the UI to fetch newly added files without closing the menu.
- The Role Name config now defaults to the active Minecraft session Username for easy resetting.
- Rewrote the auto-generated `default_script.txt` to act as a comprehensive feature showcase.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a rendering crash where empty lines at the start of a page caused 0-pixel box widths.
- Changed default toggle visibility hotkey from V to B.

releases.notes:
# Teleprompter v1.0.0!

This mod brings a highly customizable, in-game teleprompter directly to your Minecraft screen. It is designed to help content creators, actors, and directors read scripts, stage directions, and dialogue without ever having to Alt-Tab or look at a second monitor.

View the main README to see all features.
